content.text: Robot Programming: four programs, one robot.

Each program does exactly one job, and each one is short enough to read in a sitting. You start by finding the twelve numbers that make your robot stand up straight, then teach it to walk from your phone, then to dance, and finally to obey your voice.
Program 1 - pose tester: find the standing angle of every joint.
Program 2 - WiFi remote: walk and act from a phone browser.
Program 3 - dance show: arrange named moves into a performance.
Program 4 - talk to it: the AI module sends a phrase over UART, the robot acts.
Extra - add your own pose, your own button and your own voice command.
Drive all twelve servos from one dictionary and explain why a 50 Hz PWM duty value turns into a servo angle.
Find your own robot's standing numbers by testing one joint at a time instead of guessing.
Serve a web page from the ESP32 and walk the robot by tapping buttons on a phone.
Arrange named moves into a dance show by editing a single function.
Read a phrase from an AI module over UART and run the matching action.
(Extra) Add one new pose, one new web button and one new voice command of your own.
A motor with built-in feedback that holds a commanded angle, usually 0-180 degrees, driven by a pulse every 20 ms.
The width of the pulse inside each 20 ms period. On the ESP32 duty runs 0-1023, so 26 is 0 deg and 127 is 180 deg.
The set of twelve angles that makes one particular robot stand straight - every robot has its own.
A complete assignment of angles to all twelve joints; standing, bowing and squatting are all poses.
A repeating pattern of leg movements that moves the body forward without falling over.
A two-wire serial link (TX to RX, plus GND) that carries plain text between the AI module and the ESP32.

🔌 Program 1 is about 100 lines: a table of twelve angles, a table of twelve pins, one three-line helper and three test poses. Nothing else - no WiFi, no dancing, no OLED.

# ============================================================
# Biped robot - Program 1: pose tester
#
# The smallest useful program: 12 servos, one helper, three poses.
# Use it to find the number every joint needs in the standing pose.
#
# How to use:
#   1) Paste this file into Thonny.
#   2) Save it to the robot as main.py, then run it.
#   3) Watch which joint is wrong, then change ONLY the numbers in ANG.
#   4) To test one joint by hand: press Ctrl-C to stop the loop,
#      then type e.g.  w('knee_l', 150)  and press Enter.
# ============================================================

from machine import Pin, PWM
import time

# ---------- 1. Calibration: angle of every joint in the standing pose ----------
# These are the class robot's numbers. Every robot is a little different, so
# your own robot will need its own numbers. Change nothing but the numbers.
ANG = {'hip_r': 52, 'knee_r': 54, 'ankle_r': 91,
       'hip_l': 135, 'knee_l': 142, 'ankle_l': 95,
       'shoulder_r': 32, 'arm_r': 144, 'hand_r': 40,
       'shoulder_l': 146, 'arm_l': 37, 'hand_l': 153}

# ---------- 2. Which GPIO pin drives which joint ----------
# Same pin order as the wiring tutorial: right leg, left leg, right arm, left arm.
PINS = {'hip_r': 14, 'knee_r': 13, 'ankle_r': 12,
        'hip_l': 5, 'knee_l': 4, 'ankle_l': 2,
        'shoulder_r': 15, 'arm_r': 25, 'hand_r': 26,
        'shoulder_l': 27, 'arm_l': 32, 'hand_l': 33}

LEAN = 3   # forward lean while standing. Raise it if the robot tips backwards.

# One PWM channel per joint, all at 50 Hz (the rate every hobby servo expects).
srv = {j: PWM(Pin(p, Pin.OUT), freq=50) for j, p in PINS.items()}


def w(joint, deg):
    """Turn one joint to an angle in degrees.

    A servo expects a 0.5 ms pulse for 0 deg and a 2.5 ms pulse for 180 deg.
    At 50 Hz one period is 20 ms, and duty() is 0..1023 on the ESP32, so
    0 deg -> 26, 180 deg -> 127.  That is exactly  deg * 0.56 + 25.
    """
    srv[joint].duty(int(deg * 0.56) + 25)


def pose(**over):
    """Drive all twelve joints: standing pose first, then apply the overrides.

    pose(hip_r=80) means: stand, but with the right hip at 80 deg.
    """
    for j, d in ANG.items():
        w(j, d)
    for j, d in over.items():
        w(j, d)


def stand():
    """The pose the robot should hold when nothing else is happening."""
    pose(hip_r=ANG['hip_r'] + LEAN, hip_l=ANG['hip_l'] - LEAN)


# ---------- 3. Three test poses, one per group of joints ----------
# Signs matter: on the right side a bigger number lifts the limb, on the left
# side a smaller number does. That is why the left values are always negated.
def t_pose():          # both arms out sideways -> checks the two shoulders
    pose(shoulder_r=ANG['shoulder_r'] + 90,
         shoulder_l=ANG['shoulder_l'] - 90)


def squat():           # knees bent -> checks hips, knees and ankles together
    pose(hip_r=ANG['hip_r'] + 35, hip_l=ANG['hip_l'] - 35,
         knee_r=ANG['knee_r'] + 35, knee_l=ANG['knee_l'] - 35)


def wave(times=4):     # right arm up, hand swinging -> checks one single joint
    pose(shoulder_r=ANG['shoulder_r'] + 130, arm_r=90)
    for _ in range(times):
        for d in range(70, 111, 5):
            w('hand_r', d)
            time.sleep_ms(20)
        for d in range(110, 69, -5):
            w('hand_r', d)
            time.sleep_ms(20)


# ---------- 4. Run the show ----------
stand()
time.sleep(2)

while True:
    t_pose()
    time.sleep(2)
    squat()
    time.sleep(2)
    wave()
    time.sleep(1)
    stand()
    time.sleep(2)

📚 Here the wiring is one dictionary and the calibration is another, both keyed by a name you can read:
. The whole servo driver becomes twelve characters long, because the pin and the angle now live in the same place they are looked up.
⚙️ The one line worth memorising is the duty conversion. A servo wants a 0.5 ms pulse for 0 degrees and 2.5 ms for 180 degrees, out of a 20 ms period. At 50 Hz the ESP32's
spans 0-1023 across those 20 ms, so 0.5 ms is 26 counts and 2.5 ms is 127 counts. Straight-line between them:
. If you ever change the PWM frequency, this constant changes with it.
🧪 The three test poses are deliberately chosen to isolate different groups.
moves only the shoulders, so if one arm is off you know which number to touch.
moves hips, knees and ankles together, which exposes a leg that is one number away from straight.
moves a single joint through a range, so you can see where it starts buzzing at the end stop.
Run the program and let it cycle: T-pose, squat, wave, stand.
For each pose, note the joint that is wrong. Do not touch a joint that is already right.
Change that one number by 5 degrees, save, and let the program restart. Repeat until it looks symmetric.

# ============================================================ # Biped robot - Program 2: WiFi remote # # The robot joins your WiFi and serves a small web page. # Open that page on a phone in the same network and press the buttons. # # How to use: # 1) Put your WiFi name and password in WIFI_SSID / WIFI_PASS. # 2) Paste this file into Thonny, save it to the robot as main.py. # 3) Run it and read the IP address in the Shell, e.g. 192.168.1.23 # 4) Type that address into the phone browser. Keep the phone on the # same WiFi - the robot has no internet access. # ============================================================ import time import network import socket from machine import Pin, PWM # ---------- 1. Calibration (same table as Program 1) ---------- ANG = {'hip_r': 52, 'knee_r': 54, 'ankle_r': 91, 'hip_l': 135, 'knee_l': 142, 'ankle_l': 95, 'shoulder_r': 32, 'arm_r': 144, 'hand_r': 40, 'shoulder_l': 146, 'arm_l': 37, 'hand_l': 153} LEAN = 3 # forward lean while standing; raise it if the robot falls backwards SPEED = 2 # gait speed, larger value = slower AHEAD_R = 12 # side tilt (right) used to free the left foot when walking forward AHEAD_L = 12 # side tilt (left) used to free the right foot when walking forward BACK_R = 12 # side tilt used when walking backwards BACK_L = 12 KICK_DEG = 14 # body tilt while kicking RISE_DEG = 17 # thigh tuck angle used when standing up from the floor WIFI_SSID = 'MINXIN-S' WIFI_PASS = 'Minxin520' # ---------- 2. Hardware ---------- PINS = {'hip_r': 14, 'knee_r': 13, 'ankle_r': 12, 'hip_l': 5, 'knee_l': 4, 'ankle_l': 2, 'shoulder_r': 15, 'arm_r': 25, 'hand_r': 26, 'shoulder_l': 27, 'arm_l': 32, 'hand_l': 33} HIP_R = ANG['hip_r'] + LEAN # right hip angle in the standing pose HIP_L = ANG['hip_l'] - LEAN # left hip angle in the standing pose srv = {j: PWM(Pin(p, Pin.OUT), freq=50) for j, p in PINS.items()} # Last angle we told each servo to go to. Taken from the calibration table, so at # power-up the pose is known without reading anything back from the PWM hardware. pos = dict(ANG) pos['hip_r'], pos['hip_l'] = HIP_R, HIP_L def w(joint, deg): """Set one joint to an angle in degrees.""" pos[joint] = int(deg) srv[joint].duty(int(deg * 0.56) + 25) def stand(force=False): """Ease every servo back to the standing pose, all at the same time. With force=True the standing angles are written again even if the code already thinks the robot is standing, so /reset really re-drives the servos. """ target = dict(ANG) target['hip_r'], target['hip_l'] = HIP_R, HIP_L while pos != target: for j in srv: if pos[j] < target[j]: w(j, pos[j] + 1) elif pos[j] > target[j]: w(j, pos[j] - 1) time.sleep_ms(10) if force: for j, d in target.items(): w(j, d) # ---------- 3. Motions ---------- def goahead(steps=5): """Walk forward the given number of full gait cycles.""" stand() w('hip_r', HIP_R - 2) w('hip_l', HIP_L + 2) time.sleep_ms(200) # Shift the weight, step with the left leg. for a in range(AHEAD_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 30) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - AHEAD_R) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) for a in range(13): w('hip_r', HIP_R - a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - a - 4) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a + 4) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 30) # Level the body, shift to the other side, step with the right leg. for a in range(AHEAD_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - AHEAD_R + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - AHEAD_R + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(AHEAD_L): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 30) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + AHEAD_L) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) for a in range(13): w('hip_r', HIP_R - 15 + a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - 13 + a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - 13 + a - 2) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 13 + a) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] - 2 * a + 52) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) # Remaining gait cycles. for _ in range(steps): for a in range(13): w('hip_r', HIP_R + a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a - 3) w('hip_l', HIP_L + a - 2) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] + a - 3) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] - 2 * a + 26) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a - 26) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) for a in range(AHEAD_L): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + AHEAD_L - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + AHEAD_L - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(AHEAD_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - AHEAD_R) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) for a in range(13): w('hip_r', HIP_R + 13 - a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 13 - a) w('hip_l', HIP_L + 13 - a - 4) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] + 13 - a + 4) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] + 2 * a - 52) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) for a in range(13): w('hip_r', HIP_R - a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - a + 1) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a + 4) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 26 + 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] + 2 * a - 26) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) for a in range(AHEAD_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - AHEAD_R + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - AHEAD_R + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(AHEAD_L): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + AHEAD_L) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(13): w('hip_r', HIP_R - 13 + a - 2) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - 13 + a - 3) w('hip_l', HIP_L - 13 + a - 2) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 13 + a) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] - 2 * a + 52) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) stand() def goback(steps=5): """Walk backwards the given number of full gait cycles.""" stand() for a in range(3): w('hip_r', HIP_R + a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - a) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(BACK_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - BACK_R) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(15): w('hip_r', HIP_R + a + 3) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a / 3) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) for a in range(BACK_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - BACK_R + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - BACK_R + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l']) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(BACK_L): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + BACK_L) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) for _ in range(steps): for a in range(15): w('hip_r', HIP_R + 15 - a + 3) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 15 - a + 5) w('hip_l', HIP_L - 3 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 30 + 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) for a in range(BACK_L): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + BACK_L - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + BACK_L - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r']) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(BACK_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 30) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - BACK_R) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(15): w('hip_r', HIP_R + a + 3) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - 15 + a - 3) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 15 + a + 5) w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 30 - 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 30) for a in range(BACK_R): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - BACK_R + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - BACK_R + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l']) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 500) for a in range(BACK_L): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + BACK_L) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50) stand() def turnleft(): """Turn in place to the left once.""" for a in range(11): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 5 + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(16): w('hip_l', ANG['hip_l'] + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] + a) w('hip_r', ANG['hip_r'] + a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) time.sleep_ms(40) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(12): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + 10 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 30 + 30) for a in range(16): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 16 - a) time.sleep_ms(20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) for a in range(16): w('hip_l', ANG['hip_l'] + 15 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] + 15 - a) w('hip_r', ANG['hip_r'] + 15 - a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 15 - a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) def turnright(): """Turn in place to the right once.""" for a in range(11): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 5 - a) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 10 + 20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) for a in range(16): w('hip_l', ANG['hip_l'] - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a) w('hip_r', ANG['hip_r'] - a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - a) time.sleep_ms(40) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 16 + 6) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 20 + 50) for a in range(11): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] - 11 + a + 3) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 30 + 30) for a in range(16): w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 16 + a) time.sleep_ms(20) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 100 + 200) for a in range(16): w('hip_l', ANG['hip_l'] - 15 + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 15 + a) w('hip_r', ANG['hip_r'] - 15 + a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] - 15 + a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(SPEED * 50 + 50) def kick(): """Lean, swing the right leg back and kick.""" for a in range(9): w('hip_r', HIP_R + a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - a) time.sleep_ms(50) for a in range(15): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(KICK_DEG): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 15 + a) w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] + a) time.sleep_ms(80) for a in range(15): w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 30 - a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(30): w('hip_r', HIP_R + 10 - a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 2 * a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 2 * a) w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(20) time.sleep_ms(1000) w('hip_r', HIP_R + 60) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 10) time.sleep_ms(1000) stand() def pushup(): """Lie down on the hands, do three push-ups, then stand up.""" for a in range(114): w('hip_r', ANG['hip_r'] + a) w('hip_l', ANG['hip_l'] - a) w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a / 2) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a / 2) time.sleep_ms(30) for a in range(90): w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - a) time.sleep_ms(5) for a in range(57): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 57 - a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 57 + a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(114): w('hip_r', HIP_R + 114 - a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - 114 + a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(300) for _ in range(3): # number of push-ups for a in range(50): w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - a) w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 2 * a) w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + a) w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(50): w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 50 + a) w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 100 - 2 * a) w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 50 - a) w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 100 + 2 * a) time.sleep_ms(10) for a in range(100 + RISE_DEG): # tuck the thighs w('hip_r', HIP_R + a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - a) time.sleep_ms(10) time.sleep_ms(500) for a in range(60): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a) time.sleep_ms(30) for a in range(90): w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 90 - a) w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 90 + a) time.sleep_ms(5) for a in range(10): w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 60 + a) w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 60 - a) time.sleep_ms(5) for a in range(10): w('hip_r', HIP_R + 100 + RISE_DEG - a) w('hip_l', HIP_L - 100 - RISE_DEG + a) time.sleep_ms(3) for a in range(RISE_DEG): w('hip_r', HIP_R + 90 + RISE_DEG - # ============================================================
# Biped robot - Program 3: dance show
#
# Seven moves, each one a plain loop, plus a show() that strings them
# together. Change the order in show() and you have a new performance.
#
# How to use:
#   1) Paste this file into Thonny, save it to the robot as main.py.
#   2) Run it. The robot stands up, dances one round, then repeats.
#   3) Put the robot on a table with 1 m of clear space around it.
#
# Warning: the first move bends forward 70 deg. If your robot tends to fall
# forward, raise LEAN a little BEFORE dancing (see Program 1).
# ============================================================

from machine import Pin, PWM
import time

# ---------- 1. Calibration (same table as Program 1 and 2) ----------
ANG = {'hip_r': 52, 'knee_r': 54, 'ankle_r': 91,
       'hip_l': 135, 'knee_l': 142, 'ankle_l': 95,
       'shoulder_r': 32, 'arm_r': 144, 'hand_r': 40,
       'shoulder_l': 146, 'arm_l': 37, 'hand_l': 153}

LEAN = 3

PINS = {'hip_r': 14, 'knee_r': 13, 'ankle_r': 12,
        'hip_l': 5, 'knee_l': 4, 'ankle_l': 2,
        'shoulder_r': 15, 'arm_r': 25, 'hand_r': 26,
        'shoulder_l': 27, 'arm_l': 32, 'hand_l': 33}

HIP_R = ANG['hip_r'] + LEAN
HIP_L = ANG['hip_l'] - LEAN

srv = {j: PWM(Pin(p, Pin.OUT), freq=50) for j, p in PINS.items()}
pos = dict(ANG)
pos['hip_r'], pos['hip_l'] = HIP_R, HIP_L


def w(joint, deg):
    """Set one joint to an angle in degrees."""
    pos[joint] = int(deg)
    srv[joint].duty(int(deg * 0.56) + 25)


def stand():
    """Ease every joint back to the standing pose, all at the same time."""
    target = dict(ANG)
    target['hip_r'], target['hip_l'] = HIP_R, HIP_L
    while pos != target:
        for j in ANG:
            if pos[j] < target[j]:
                w(j, pos[j] + 1)
            elif pos[j] > target[j]:
                w(j, pos[j] - 1)
        time.sleep_ms(8)


# ---------- 2. The moves ----------
# Every move is the same shape: a loop that walks one variable from 0 to N,
# with each joint written as  base + k * variable.  Change k and the joint
# moves further; change the loop length and the move gets slower.
# Reminder for the signs: right side = bigger angle lifts, left side = smaller.

def bow():                              # 鞠躬 - fold forward from the hips
    for a in range(70):
        w('hip_r', ANG['hip_r'] + a)
        w('hip_l', ANG['hip_l'] - a)
        w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + a / 2)
        w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - a / 2)
        w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + a)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + a)
        time.sleep_ms(10)
    time.sleep_ms(600)
    for a in range(70):
        w('hip_r', ANG['hip_r'] + 70 - a)
        w('hip_l', ANG['hip_l'] - 70 + a)
        w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + 35 - a / 2)
        w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - 35 + a / 2)
        w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 70 - a)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 70 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(10)


def nod():                              # 点头 - tap the right toe twice
    for _ in range(2):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 13 - a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)


def twist():                            # 扭胯 - hips sway, arms punch out one at a time
    for _ in range(4):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - a)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 100 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 70)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 90 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 2 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 14 - a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 14 + a)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 72 + 2 * a)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 70)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 62 + 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 28 - 2 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
    for _ in range(4):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - a)
            w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 100 + 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 70)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90 + 2 * a)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] - 2 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 14 - a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 14 + a)
            w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 72 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 70)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 62 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] - 28 + 2 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)


def flap():                             # 摆臂 - both arms swing like wings
    for _ in range(4):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - a)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 80 - 2 * a)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 4 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 14 - a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 14 + a)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 52 + 2 * a)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 28 - 2 * a)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 56 + 4 * a)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
    for _ in range(4):
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - a)
            w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 140 + 2 * a)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 90)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 90)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 140 - 2 * a)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
            time.sleep_ms(17)
        for a in range(14):
            w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 14 - a)
            w('ankle_l', ANG['ankle_l'] - 14 + a)
            w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 112 - 2 * a)
            w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 90)
            w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 90)
            w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 112 + 2 * a)
            w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 90)
            w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
            time.sleep_ms(17)


def toe_tap():                          # 点脚 - toe taps while both arms are up
    w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 90)
    w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 90)
    w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 90)
    w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 90)
    for a in range(14):
        w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + a)
        w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 75 + 2 * a)
        w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 105 + 2 * a)
        time.sleep_ms(17)
    for a in range(14):
        w('ankle_r', ANG['ankle_r'] + 13 - a)
        w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 103 - 2 * a)
        w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 77 - 2 * a)
        time.sleep_ms(17)


def fan(base, step, open_arm):
    """One 20-step slice of the peacock move.

    base = where the hips start, step = +1 while going down, -1 while coming up,
    open_arm picks which of the two arm poses this slice uses.
    """
    if open_arm:
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 70)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] - 60)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 130)
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 30)
    else:
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 130)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 30)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 70)
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 60)
    for a in range(20):
        h = base + step * a
        w('hip_r', ANG['hip_r'] + h)
        w('knee_r', ANG['knee_r'] + h / 2)
        w('hip_l', ANG['hip_l'] - h)
        w('knee_l', ANG['knee_l'] - h / 2)
        time.sleep_ms(25)


def peacock():                          # 孔雀开屏 - deep squat, arms open and close
    w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'] + 70)
    w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'] - 70)
    fan(0, 1, True)
    fan(20, 1, False)
    fan(40, 1, True)
    fan(60, 1, False)
    fan(80, -1, True)
    fan(60, -1, False)
    fan(40, -1, True)
    fan(20, -1, False)


def lotus():                            # 莲花手 - the arm flourish at the end
    w('shoulder_r', ANG['shoulder_r'])
    w('shoulder_l', ANG['shoulder_l'])
    w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 100)
    w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 100)
    w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'])
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(40):
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 20 - 2 * a)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 100 + a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(40):
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 140 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] - 60 + 4 * a)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 100 - a)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + a)
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 100 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_l', ANG['hand_l'] + 20 - a)
        w('arm_l', ANG['arm_l'] + 80 + a)
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 20 + 2 * a)
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 120 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(40):
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 140 + a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] + 60 - 4 * a)
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 100 + a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)
    for a in range(20):
        w('hand_r', ANG['hand_r'] - 20 + a)
        w('arm_r', ANG['arm_r'] - 80 - a)
        time.sleep_ms(8)


# ---------- 3. The show ----------
# One line per move. Reorder them, repeat them, delete them - that is the
# whole choreography language.
def show():
    stand()
    nod()
    nod()
    twist()
    twist()
    flap()
    toe_tap()
    toe_tap()
    toe_tap()
    toe_tap()
    peacock()
    lotus()
    lotus()
    bow()
    stand()


# ---------- 4. Run ----------
stand()
time.sleep(1)

while True:
    show()
    time.sleep(2)

# ============================================================
# Biped robot - Program 4: talk to it
#
# The AI is NOT in this program. The AI module (XIAO ZHI) does the
# listening and the thinking, then sends one short Chinese phrase over
# UART. This program only has to recognise that phrase and act.
#
# How to use:
#   1) Wire the AI module to UART2: its TX -> GPIO16 (RX), its RX -> GPIO17,
#      and share GND. Baud rate 115200.
#   2) Paste this file into Thonny, save it to the robot as main.py.
#   3) Paste the prompt of section 3 into the AI module (see the chapter).
#   4) Say "挥挥手" and watch the OLED face change, then the arm move.
# ============================================================

from machine import Pin, PWM, UART, I2C
import ssd1306
import time

# ---------- 1. Calibration (same table as Program 1-3) ----------
ANG = {'hip_r': 52, 'knee_r': 54, 'ankle_r': 91,
       'hip_l': 135, 'knee_l': 142, 'ankle_l': 95,
       'shoulder_r': 32, 'arm_r': 144, 'hand_r': 40,
       'shoulder_l': 146, 'arm_l': 37, 'hand_l': 153}

LEAN = 3

PINS = {'hip_r': 14, 'knee_r': 13, 'ankle_r': 12,
        'hip_l': 5, 'knee_l': 4, 'ankle_l': 2,
        'shoulder_r': 15, 'arm_r': 25, 'hand_r': 26,
        'shoulder_l': 27, 'arm_l': 32, 'hand_l': 33}

HIP_R = ANG['hip_r'] + LEAN
HIP_L = ANG['hip_l'] - LEAN

srv = {j: PWM(Pin(p, Pin.OUT), freq=50) for j, p in PINS.items()}
pos = dict(ANG)
pos['hip_r'], pos['hip_l'] = HIP_R, HIP_L


def w(joint, deg):
    pos[joint] = int(deg)
    srv[joint].duty(int(deg * 0.56) + 25)


def ramp(target, steps=20, ms=15):
    """Move several joints to new angles at the same time.

    target is a dict like {'shoulder_r': 140, 'hand_r': 90}. Joints that are
    not in target keep their angle. The move is spread over `steps` frames so
    the servos glide instead of jumping - a jump risks a fall.
    """
    start = {j: pos[j] for j in target}
    for i in range(1, steps + 1):
        for j, d in target.items():
            w(j, start[j] + (d - start[j]) * i / steps)
        time.sleep_ms(ms)


def stand(steps=18):
    """Back to the standing pose, whatever the robot was doing before."""
    target = dict(ANG)
    target['hip_r'] = HIP_R
    target['hip_l'] = HIP_L
    ramp(target, steps, 12)


# ---------- 2. A face that shows what the robot thinks ----------
i2c = I2C(scl=Pin(22), sda=Pin(23))
oled = ssd1306.SSD1306_I2C(128, 64, i2c)


def face(mood='idle'):
    """Draw one of three moods with plain rectangles and lines - no bitmaps."""
    oled.fill(0)
    if mood == 'happy':
        oled.fill_rect(40, 24, 10, 4, 1)          # eyes, half closed
        oled.fill_rect(78, 24, 10, 4, 1)
        oled.hline(50, 44, 6, 1)                  # a smile made of three lines
        oled.hline(56, 47, 16, 1)
        oled.hline(72, 44, 6, 1)
    elif mood == 'angry':
        oled.line(38, 20, 52, 27, 1)              # slanted brows
        oled.line(90, 20, 76, 27, 1)
        oled.fill_rect(42, 32, 10, 6, 1)
        oled.fill_rect(76, 32, 10, 6, 1)
        oled.hline(52, 50, 24, 1)                 # flat mouth
    else:                                         # idle
        oled.fill_rect(42, 24, 10, 10, 1)
        oled.fill_rect(76, 24, 10, 10, 1)
        oled.hline(54, 46, 20, 1)
    oled.show()


# ---------- 3. Six actions the voice can trigger ----------
def wave():
    ramp({'shoulder_r': ANG['shoulder_r'] + 130, 'arm_r': 95})
    for _ in range(3):
        ramp({'hand_r': 70}, 6, 20)
        ramp({'hand_r': 110}, 6, 20)
    stand()


def bow():
    ramp({'hip_r': ANG['hip_r'] + 45, 'hip_l': ANG['hip_l'] - 45,
          'knee_r': ANG['knee_r'] + 22, 'knee_l': ANG['knee_l'] - 22,
          'shoulder_r': ANG['shoulder_r'] + 45})
    time.sleep_ms(500)
    stand()


def kick():
    ramp({'hip_r': HIP_R + 12, 'hip_l': HIP_L - 12})        # lean back a little
    ramp({'knee_r': ANG['knee_r'] + 55}, 12, 20)            # wind up
    ramp({'knee_r': ANG['knee_r'], 'ankle_r': ANG['ankle_r'] + 25}, 6, 8)   # kick!
    time.sleep_ms(400)
    stand()


def punch():
    ramp({'shoulder_r': ANG['shoulder_r'] + 110,
          'shoulder_l': ANG['shoulder_l'] - 110,
          'arm_r': ANG['arm_r'] - 60, 'arm_l': ANG['arm_l'] + 60})
    for _ in range(2):
        ramp({'arm_r': ANG['arm_r'], 'arm_l': ANG['arm_l']}, 5, 6)     # out
        ramp({'arm_r': ANG['arm_r'] - 60, 'arm_l': ANG['arm_l'] + 60}, 5, 6)
    stand()


def squat():
    ramp({'hip_r': ANG['hip_r'] + 30, 'hip_l': ANG['hip_l'] - 30,
          'knee_r': ANG['knee_r'] + 30, 'knee_l': ANG['knee_l'] - 30})
    time.sleep_ms(600)
    stand()


def dance():
    bow()
    wave()
    kick()


# ---------- 4. What the AI module says -> what the robot does ----------
# (phrase to look for, face to show, action to run)
# The phrase is in Chinese because the AI module speaks Chinese. If you set the
# module up in English, just edit the left column.
CMDS = (('挥手', 'happy', wave),
        ('鞠躬', 'happy', bow),
        ('踢球', 'angry', kick),
        ('打拳', 'angry', punch),
        ('蹲下', 'idle', squat),
        ('跳舞', 'happy', dance),
        ('起立', 'idle', stand))

uart = UART(2, 115200)          # GPIO16 = RX, GPIO17 = TX on the ESP32


def listen():
    """Read one line from the AI module, run the first matching command."""
    if not uart.any():
        return
    try:
        line = uart.readline().decode('utf-8').strip()
    except Exception:            # half a line, wrong baud rate, noise
        return
    if not line:
        return
    print('heard:', line)
    for key, mood, action in CMDS:
        if key in line:
            face(mood)
            action()
            face('idle')
            return


# ---------- 5. Run ----------
stand()
face('idle')
print('ready')

while True:
    listen()
    time.sleep_ms(20)            # 50 checks per second is plenty for speech

🗣️ The AI module cannot guess what to send, so you tell it. Open its configuration and give it this instruction - the phrases must match the left column of the table exactly, including the two characters 好的 in front.

You control a small biped robot. When I ask you to do something,
answer with exactly one of these phrases and nothing else:
  挥挥手 -> "好的挥手"

  站起来 -> "好的起立"
If I ask for anything else, answer "好的起立".
🧩 It is worth being precise about this, because it is the most misunderstood part of the project. The speech recognition, the language model and the reasoning all run on the
. What reaches the ESP32 is a short string over two wires. The ESP32 does not know what a word means; it only knows that

🧠 That is why the program is so short, and also why it is reliable: the boundary is text. You can swap the AI module for a phone app, a laptop script or another robot and the ESP32 side does not change at all. The only contract is "send me one of these seven phrases".

📷 The module also has a camera. Ask it "what is in front of you" and it answers in speech - that part needs no code on the robot, because the answer never leaves the module. The robot's job in that conversation is the face on the OLED, not the description.
